title: First professional job and Lawrence Toca
summary: At about twelve he played with his cousin Lawrence Marrero around Franklin and Charters; also jobs with trumpeter Toca.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: The first job I played, I'll tell you what, I was about 12 years old when I played my first professional job. That was Lawrence Morell, my cousin. You remember Lawrence Morell? Oh yeah. Yeah, well Lawrence was one of the fellas, you know. Well me and Lawrence, sometime we used to hide his fellas, he used to jump. You know what I'm telling you about, what we used to do in that time, we used to play jobs around Franklin Avenue and Charters, Ellison Field and Decatur. See, all around up in there. That's where all the work was then. It wasn't all for everything. I was going to go to Hoover Street.
What about Toker? Did you ever work with Toker? Lawrence Toker? Oh yeah.

I'm glad you mention that. I'm sure glad you mention that. I forgot about him Toker. Yeah, that man hired me on a plenty little thing. Toker the trumpet player on a little Toker, sure. Yeah, I did a plenty thing with Toker. I know there was somebody I was there. I don't know it was somebody I was trying to think about. That's right.
